A = np.diag([1.0, 0.1])
x_true = np.array([1.0,1.0])
b = A@x_true + np.array([0.0,0.01])
U, sigma, Vt = np.linalg.svd(A)
print("测量/奇异值:", b, sigma)
print("精确伪逆解:", np.linalg.pinv(A)@b)
print("条件数/正规方程条件数:", np.linalg.cond(A), np.linalg.cond(A.T@A))
for delta, tau in [(0.01,0.05),(0.01,0.2),(0.0,0.2)]:
    y = A@x_true + np.array([0.0,delta])
    reciprocal = np.zeros_like(sigma)
    keep = sigma > tau
    reciprocal[keep] = 1/sigma[keep]
    x = Vt.T@(reciprocal*(U.T@y))
    print("噪声/阈值/截断解/解误差/残差:", delta, tau, x, np.linalg.norm(x-x_true), np.linalg.norm(y-A@x))

L, U = sp.Matrix([[1,0],[2,1]]), sp.Matrix([[2,1],[0,1]])
w = L.lower_triangular_solve(sp.Matrix([3,7]))

print("题3残差/平方/正交:", list(r), r.dot(r), list(A.T*r))

B, y = sp.diag(2,0), sp.Matrix([4,3])
t = sp.symbols('t', real=True)
x = sp.Matrix([2,t])
print("题5奇异值/伪逆/选解:", B.singular_values(), B.pinv().tolist(), list(B.pinv()*y))
print("题5残差/平方/解平方:", list(y-B*x), (y-B*x).dot(y-B*x), x.dot(x))
S, real_x = sp.diag(1,sp.Rational(1,10)), sp.ones(2,1)
y = S*real_x+sp.Matrix([0,-sp.Rational(2,100)])
exact, truncated = S.inv()*y, sp.Matrix([1,0])
print("题6测量/精确解/误差:", list(y), list(exact), (exact-real_x).norm())
print("题6条件数:", S.condition_number(), (S.T*S).condition_number())
print("题6截断残差/解误差/无噪残差:", (y-S*truncated).norm(), (truncated-real_x).norm(), (S*real_x-S*truncated).norm())
